name: Ancien des caravanes
description: Very old broad adult, pale ochre speckled skin, deep brow folds, one shorter natural mandible tusk, long silver-black dreads. Long repaired sand-cloth travel coat, bronze collar clasp, wide belt, soft leg wraps. Leans slightly on a short functional luggage support handle attached to a small held folding pack frame; no magical staff. Other hand holds a worn compact compass. Firm weathered presence.
